mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is always below 100% in the US, and historically, S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days are positive when FEDFUNDS is below 100%, which is always true. Therefore, the signal is always active and predicts positive returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances (which is always true) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle, which increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises by more than 0.5% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) rises by more than 0.3% over the past 3 months, it signals a dual threat of monetary tightening and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3% in the past 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3% in the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals a weak labor market and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 2000 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing market and weak economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 2000, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (2017=100), it signals a contraction in the industrial sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 2000 thousand units and industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (2017=100), it signals a simultaneous contraction in the housing market and industrial sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 2000 and INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) rise by more than 0.5% over the past 3 months, it signals strong consumer spending and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises > 0.5% in the past 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS rises > 0.5% in the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.
